purpose: Mine a source-grounded DoD facilities vocabulary and support scoped agency, jurisdiction, organizational, and Community of Practice extensions.

primary_corpus.scope: Published UFC documents available in the digital library; track broader program coverage separately.
primary_corpus.authority: DoD criteria subject to the document's authority, applicability, edition, implementation rules, and exceptions.

primary_corpus.source_format: SpecsIntact SEC XML, preserved as original archive member bytes
primary_corpus.scope: Every SEC member in the identified UFGS master snapshot, including malformed members retained for remediation.
primary_corpus.authority: Published guide specification text; retain designer notes, tailoring choices, agency scope, and project incorporation separately.

authority_context: Applicable DoD policies and project instruments

authority_statement: MIL-STD-3007G supplies the documented program-governance, development, approval, and issuance framework for UFC, FC, and UFGS under the authorities it identifies. UFC and UFGS are the primary authoritative technical corpus from which this project derives DoD facilities terminology. Each vocabulary assertion retains its source, edition, scope, and review status; the derived vocabulary is not itself a DoD-issued instrument.

rights_policy.basis: U.S. Government-authored material where 17 U.S.C. 105 applies
rights_policy.scope: United States copyright treatment; no blanket global or whole-corpus clearance assertion
rights_policy.third_party_material: Preserve notices and attribution; referenced or reproduced third-party text does not automatically inherit the government-work reuse basis.

semantic_rules: Preserve immutable raw bytes and source hashes before normalization.
Preserve exact source text alongside separately normalized labels and search text.
Treat explicit definitions and synonym statements as scoped source assertions, never as universal equivalence by default.
Keep term occurrence, definition, preferred label, relationship, and requirement as separate records.
Do not promote recurring headings or frequent phrases directly to accepted ontology classes.
Do not treat every phrase in an authoritative document as a legally defined term.
Preserve modality, conditions, exceptions, applicability, source edition, and project applicability for requirements.
Keep designer notes and commentary distinct from operative text.
Keep UFGS bracketed choices, tailoring tags, unit alternatives, agency variants, and project selections explicit.
Retain conflicting definitions as separate scoped senses until reviewed; frequency does not resolve authority.
Record mappings as exact, close, broader, narrower, or related with evidence and review status.
Preserve syntax failures and missing sources in the corpus inventory; do not silently repair or discard evidence.
Keep vocabulary release versions independent of source publication versions.
Keep source authority, organizational context, semantic specialization, and community presentation separate.
USACE ER and EM are parallel source families; do not impose a universal rank relative to UFC or UFGS.
Keep local explanations separate from source definitions and review fidelity before presenting them as faithful summaries.
Separate senses when an agency or community uses an identical label with a different meaning.
Require evidence for local amendments and precedence, including jurisdiction, subject matter, editions, and exceptions.
Pin derivative profiles to adopted source editions; a newer corpus snapshot does not silently update a derivative code profile.
mining_order: Section titles, tagged headings, named systems, materials, processes, roles, and deliverables
Cross-document reconciliation and externally reviewed vocabulary mappings
release_gates: Traceable source evidence for every published concept and semantic assertion
Explicit editorial acceptance with retained change history
No unresolved source corruption for the evidence used by an accepted record
Source-level and excerpt-level rights classification for redistributed content
Coverage reported separately for source acquisition, syntax parsing, semantic extraction, and adjudication
Evaluation on independently adjudicated examples and retrieval questions
Version-pinned profile imports and explicit disposition of upstream edition changes
Scope and cited authority for every accepted amendment or precedence relationship
Local explanation fidelity and visible unresolved conflicts
Extension-source acquisition, extraction, and adjudication coverage reported separately from the original baseline

governance_foundation.role: Foundational program-governance and authority source for the UFC/UFGS corpus
governance_foundation.scope: Authority source and definitions included separately from UFC/UFGS technical-corpus counts

vocabulary_framework.profile_import_rule: Published imports pin vocabulary releases and adopted source editions. Draft unresolved imports confer no authority and cannot produce an accepted governing definition.
vocabulary_framework.authority_rule: Resolve applicability before precedence. Apply only an evidenced authority relationship within its documented scope; otherwise retain competing assertions.
vocabulary_framework.organization_rule: Organizational membership and profile ancestry do not create authority to redefine or override an inherited source assertion.
vocabulary_framework.community_view_rule: Display local labels and explanations with inheritance status, accessible governing wording and edition, and visible unresolved conflicts.
vocabulary_framework.change_rule: Upstream changes create impact-review candidates and preserve prior releases; do not automatically update adopted editions or project codes of record.
vocabulary_framework.access_rule: Profile imports inherit no automatic permission to disclose source text; retain source-level access and redistribution conditions.
